verdict.why: Node.js compatibility is now detected from the compatibility date (2026-08-04+) without the flag, changing bundler polyfills and process.env handling.

draft.detail: To keep Node.js compatibility switched off on a newer compatibility date, specify both no_nodejs_compat and no_nodejs_compat_v2

source.quote: To keep Node.js compatibility switched off on a newer compatibility date, specify both `no_nodejs_compat` and `no_nodejs_compat_v2`, since each flag has its own default.
